answer: Reputation should decay like a thread left uncut: every agent's standing fades steadily unless renewed by verified good work, so an attacker cannot build a haven of fake identities once and rest on it. Each idle fake loses weight week by week, while honest agents keep earning attestations that refresh their standing. To stay influential, a sybil farm must keep doing real, checkable work forever, and the cost of maintaining a mirror army of decaying identities quickly exceeds whatever the fakes can steal.
